title: 数据清洗
objective: 识别重复、缺失、异常和格式不一致。

knowledgePoints.title: 识别重复与去重规则
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 能够运用本节知识完成：发现重复导入数据
knowledgePoints.concept: 重复记录由业务键决定，不是任意字段相同就删除；先报告重复，再确定保留规则。

parameters.business_key: 定义同一业务对象的字段

columns.name: name
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

columns.name: amount
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

columns.name: category
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: SELECT TRIM(name) AS clean_name,amount,LOWER(category) AS clean_category,COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count FROM raw_data GROUP BY TRIM(name),amount,LOWER(category) HAVING COUNT(*)>1;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: SELECT TRIM(name) AS clean_name,amount,LOWER(category) AS clean_category,COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count FROM raw_data GROUP BY TRIM(name),amount,LOWER(category) HAVING COUNT(*)>1;
executionSteps: 按名称、金额及类别分组
knowledgePoints.comparison: DISTINCT 能去掉投影后的重复行，但不能决定保留哪一条业务记录。

commonError.example: 直接 DELETE 相同金额的记录
commonError.correction: 先定义业务键与保留顺序

knowledgePoints.notes: 相同商品和金额可能是合法交易；本例只标记疑似重复。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

knowledgePoints.title: 缺失与异常检测
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 能够运用本节知识完成：生成数据质量检查报告
knowledgePoints.concept: 先定义规则，再标记异常；空字符串、NULL、负值及零值有不同含义。
knowledgePoints.syntax: CASE WHEN condition THEN label ... END

columns.name: name
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

columns.name: amount
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

columns.name: category
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: SELECT id,CASE WHEN name IS NULL OR TRIM(name)='' THEN '名称缺失' WHEN amount IS NULL THEN '金额缺失' WHEN CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2))<0 THEN '负金额待核' ELSE '通过' END AS quality FROM raw_data ORDER BY id;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: SELECT id,CASE WHEN name IS NULL OR TRIM(name)='' THEN '名称缺失' WHEN amount IS NULL THEN '金额缺失' WHEN CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2))<0 THEN '负金额待核' ELSE '通过' END AS quality FROM raw_data ORDER BY id;
executionSteps: 在已知合法数字文本中识别负值
knowledgePoints.useCase: 生成数据质量检查报告
knowledgePoints.comparison: 异常值不是必然错误，例如退款可以为负数。

commonError.correction: 保留原值并按业务核实

knowledgePoints.notes: 样例金额文本已知合法；实际导入必须先验证数字格式。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

knowledgePoints.title: CAST 与分类标准化
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 能够运用本节知识完成：将原始数据整理成分析字段
knowledgePoints.concept: CAST 显式转换类型；先清理空白和格式，再验证合法性并转换，最后统一类别。

columns.name: name
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

columns.name: amount
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

columns.name: category
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: SELECT id,CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS numeric_amount,CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='skin' THEN '护肤品' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='home' THEN '日用品' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='makeup' THEN '化妆品' ELSE '待分类' END AS clean_category FROM raw_data ORDER BY id;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: SELECT id,CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS numeric_amount,CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='skin' THEN '护肤品' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='home' THEN '日用品' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='makeup' THEN '化妆品' ELSE '待分类' END AS clean_category FROM raw_data ORDER BY id;
executionSteps: 确认输入为数字文本或NULL
knowledgePoints.useCase: 将原始数据整理成分析字段
knowledgePoints.comparison: CAST 改变表达式类型，不代表已修改源数据。

commonError.example: CAST 任意字符串并认为一定有效
commonError.correction: 先验证格式并隔离非法输入

knowledgePoints.notes: 本例数字为整数；SQLite DECIMAL 不提供 MySQL 精确十进制保障。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

summary: 完成本章后：识别重复、缺失、异常和格式不一致。
